_doc: questionPages and answerPages use the same syntax as the Setup form: comma-separated page numbers and ranges, 1-based. Examples: '3-10, 13-29' or '1'. Leave answerPages blank for one-page extract papers without an answer sheet — the app will warn that normal answer-key marking cannot run, but student-answer extraction still works.
